content.title: Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival
content.text: Go live in the desert with the official Coachella livestream April 10-12 and 17-19. Enjoy a front-row view of performances from your favorite artists, only on YouTube. With 7 stages streaming live, there’s always an incredible set to catch. Head to the official Coachella YouTube channel so you don’t miss a beat. Download the Coachella Livestream App More sets. More stages. More ways to watch. Optimize your Coachella Livestream experience using the new livestream app. View the full livestream and replay schedule - synced to your time zone. Choose Your Own Adventure - create a personalized livestream schedule and set reminders so you don’t miss your favorite sets. Discover with Google Gemini - go beyond your favorites. Let Gemini help you discover and explore new artists to add to your schedule. Relive the Highlights - Watch the best of the festival’s live performances on demand. Shop livestream-exclusive festival and artist merchandise. In the Know - Get the latest Coachella news. Dive deeper into the festival with YouTube's enhanced livestream experience Multiview: With multiview* you can watch up to four live stages simultaneously right on your TV through the YouTube app. This means you can control your audio by toggling between feeds, ensuring you catch every moment of your favorite performances, even if they're at the same time. *Restrictions apply to multiview. Watch With: Coming back for 2026, Watch With allows creators to engage with live events through commentary and real-time reactions, giving you the experience of watching Coachella alongside your favorite creator. These livestreams will be available on the creators’ channels on mobile, desktop, and TV. Vertical livestream: Bringing even more live music to YouTube Shorts, we're executing a dedicated vertical livestream with exclusive angles, filmed fully on Pixel devices. Merchandise: YouTube Shopping is making it easier than ever to bring the festival merchandise tent to you. Snag official merchandise from Coachella and over a dozen artists without leaving the livestream. Whether you're on mobile, desktop, or watching on your TV, all you have to do is click the shopping button on screen or scan the QR code to find your favorite keepsake. New this year, mobile viewers can enjoy an even faster accelerated checkout. Simply tap the "Buy Now" button to open an overlay, select your size, and you can complete your purchase instantly while the performance continues to play uninterrupted. Alistair Nicholls interprets the livestream through handmade claymation. The director and artist working in Norwich/London loves embracing the tactile, handmade feel of stop-motion and how it allows the fingerprints and slightly wobbly style of the medium shine through.
